# githubsettings_repository_archived_settings (Resource)

Record the merge settings of an archived repository. Use the values GitHub currently reports for the repository. If the plan shows a difference, check those settings in GitHub before applying. Apply fails while the configured values differ. Give the token read access to the repository.

Removing this resource from Terraform management leaves the GitHub setting in place.

## Import the current setting

1. Match the resource arguments to the values GitHub currently reports.
2. Add the import block below. Replace the example ID and address with those of your resource.
3. Run `terraform plan`. For one import, apply only when it reports `1 to import, 0 to add, 0 to change, 0 to destroy`.

```terraform
import {
  to = githubsettings_repository_archived_settings.example
  id = "example-owner/example-repository"
}
```

## Example configuration

```terraform
resource "githubsettings_repository_archived_settings" "example" {
  owner      = "example-owner"
  repository = "example-repository"

  allow_auto_merge            = false
  allow_forking               = false
  allow_merge_commit          = true
  allow_rebase_merge          = true
  allow_squash_merge          = true
  allow_update_branch         = false
  delete_branch_on_merge      = false
  merge_commit_message        = "PR_TITLE"
  merge_commit_title          = "MERGE_MESSAGE"
  squash_merge_commit_message = "COMMIT_MESSAGES"
  squash_merge_commit_title   = "COMMIT_OR_PR_TITLE"
  web_commit_signoff_required = false
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `allow_auto_merge` (Boolean) Allow auto-merge for pull requests.
- `allow_forking` (Boolean) Allow users to fork the repository.
- `allow_merge_commit` (Boolean) Allow merge commits.
- `allow_rebase_merge` (Boolean) Allow rebase merging.
- `allow_squash_merge` (Boolean) Allow squash merging.
- `allow_update_branch` (Boolean) Allow branches to be updated from their pull requests.
- `delete_branch_on_merge` (Boolean) Delete head branches after pull requests merge.
- `merge_commit_message` (String) Merge commit message. Allowed values are PR_BODY, PR_TITLE, BLANK.
- `merge_commit_title` (String) Merge commit title. Allowed values are PR_TITLE, MERGE_MESSAGE.
- `owner` (String) GitHub account that owns the repository or organization.
- `repository` (String) GitHub repository name within the owner account.
- `squash_merge_commit_message` (String) Squash merge commit message. Allowed values are PR_BODY, COMMIT_MESSAGES, BLANK.
- `squash_merge_commit_title` (String) Squash merge commit title. Allowed values are PR_TITLE, COMMIT_OR_PR_TITLE.
- `web_commit_signoff_required` (Boolean) Require contributors to sign off on web-based commits.

### Read-Only

- `archived` (Boolean) Whether GitHub reports the repository as archived.
